subject: Molten Core bosses other than Lucifron and Baron Geddon: Classic Era encounter sources for every class

retrieval.method: Fetched once per page through the implementing agent's fetch tool (wiki.gg blocks plain HTTP clients). The tool returns quotes extracted by a small model from the converted page and splits long sentences into consecutive quotes; excerpts below are those quotes. Season of Discovery and Season of Mastery content was excluded at fetch time.
retrieval.boundary: Excerpts are guide text, not observations. Strategy sentences describe one guild approach among several; a rule built on them must say so and must not grade a player against an assignment the log cannot show.

excerpts.panic: Panics nearby enemies, causing them to flee in fear for 8 sec.
excerpts.lava_bomb: Throws a Lava Bomb at an enemy, inflicting 4800 Fire damage over 12 sec.
excerpts.magma_spit: Spews Fire damage at the target, dealing additional Fire damage every 3 sec.
excerpts.healers_max_range: Healers need to stand at max range behind the main tank.
excerpts.max_range_avoids_fear: If you are at max range you will be able to heal the tank, but too far away to be affected by the AOE fear.
excerpts.ranges: Healing range is 40 yards, and AoE fear range is 30 yards, so this should be easy.
excerpts.cleanse_range_hint: (Hint: if you can cast dispel or cleanse on the main tank, you are too close.)
excerpts.fear_ward: Priests should keep Fear Ward on the main tank.
excerpts.two_healer_groups: A guild new to Magmadar may wish to have 2 groups of MT healers, only one of which is on the MT at a time.

excerpts.curse: Reduces healing effects for nearby enemies by 75% for 5 min.
excerpts.range_layout: Make sure Gehennas is far enough away that the only people in range of his curse, shadow bolt, and rain of fire / are the main tank and his healers/decursers.
excerpts.decurser: The MT on Gehennas will need a dedicated decurser usually a mage, but a druid will work as well.
excerpts.remove_fast: The tank must have the curse removed as soon as possible.
excerpts.healing_limit: Gehennas deals a fair amount of damage and you will not be able to keep the tank up / if he is only receiving 25% of the healing.
excerpts.decurse_priority: Mages and druids in this fight should be sure to adjust their decursing priority list to place the MT at the top, / followed by other melee players, as the curse greatly reduces the amount of healing a player can receive.

excerpts.antimagic_pulse: Dispels magic on nearby enemies, removing 1 beneficial spell effect.
excerpts.magma_shackles: Reduces the movement speed of nearby enemies by 60% for 15 sec.
excerpts.firesworn_immolate: Inflicts 337 Fire damage to an enemy and scorches it for an additional 168 damage every 3 sec. for 21 sec.
excerpts.eruption: Deals 22194 Fire damage to all nearby enemies, knocking them back.
excerpts.explosions_save_mana: When they are about to die, melee must get away from firesworns so as to save health and save healer mana.
excerpts.strategy_2_healing: This can be tricky as the tank will obviously require a tremendous amount of healing.
excerpts.strategy_2_immolate_removal: Several paladins or priests need to be constantly removing the Immolates from the tank.

excerpts.arcane_explosion: Sends out a blast wave of magic, inflicting 925 to 1075 Arcane damage to nearby enemies. (20 yard range)
excerpts.curse: Increases the magical damage taken by nearby enemies by 100% for 5 min.
excerpts.counterspell: Counters the spellcasting of nearby enemies, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec.
excerpts.blink: (About every 45 seconds Shazzrah will blink to random target causing a wipe of the threat list)
excerpts.decursers: Shazzrah's Curse must be removed immediately by Mages and Druids, starting with the main tank
excerpts.curse_range: Since the curse's range is only 35 yards, Druids can stand back 5 more yards and heal the main tanks
excerpts.healers_spread: Healers should be stationed throughout the circle to heal up the people near the blink point.

excerpts.dark_mending: Uses dark magic to heal an ally for 27750 to 32250 damage.
excerpts.shadow_word_pain: Utters a word of darkness, inflicting Shadow damage to an enemy every 3 sec. for 18 sec.
excerpts.immolate: Inflicts 760 to 840 Fire damage to an enemy and scorches it for an additional 380 to 420 damage / every 3 sec. for 21 sec.
excerpts.debuffs_worse: The magic debuffs from the guards are much worse than the melee damage, and will generally target / the off-tanks and their healers.
excerpts.dispel_priority: Dispelling these debuffs should be absolute priority for Priests for Horde, or Paladins for Alliance.
excerpts.fire_resist: Fire resist totems / auras also help.
excerpts.shared_healers: This can be an easier strategy because the tanks can share healers if one goes down or runs out of mana.

excerpts.magma_splash: Splashes the target with Magma, melting its armor, dealing Fire damage and additional Fire damage for 30 sec.
excerpts.mana_long_fight: and healers need to pay some attention to their mana pools, since it's a rather long fight.
excerpts.tank_fire_resistance: The main tank needs high fire resistance (to reduce the effect of the magma splashes),
excerpts.dots_swap: If the main tank gets too many DoTs on him it will be simply impossible to keep him up.

excerpts.magic_reflection: Causes all nearby allies to reflect 50% of harmful spells for 10 sec.
excerpts.teleport: Teleports an enemy into the midst of burning coals.
excerpts.shadow_shock: Instantly lashes nearby enemies with dark magic, inflicting Shadow damage.
excerpts.pull: The MT, a hunter, and a paladin will engage Executus.
excerpts.divine_shield_pull: The paladin will pull with divine shield.
excerpts.teleport_target: This paladin will attempt to stand closer to Executus than the MT throughout the fight; / Executus usually teleports the closest player to him to the fire pit.
excerpts.paladin_mage_pairs: Each Paladin, except the portal caster, is assigned to a Mage.
excerpts.broken_sheep: If the healer unsheeps while shield is up or the Mage dies, pally needs to stun or off tank till shield is down.
excerpts.mana_efficiency: This battle is a test of the mana efficiency of the healers, who should bring as many Major Mana Potions as possible.

conflicts.paladin_mage_pairs: The guide excludes a 'portal caster' Paladin from the Mage pairs without explaining the role; guidance omits that exception and keeps only the conditional raid-assigned pairing.

excerpts.wrath_ranged: This attack targets a random player with a mana bar and knocks back all players (excluding the target) within ~20 yards.
excerpts.sons: After 3 minutes of combat Ragnaros will summon 8 Sons of Flame and submerge.
excerpts.fire_resistance_key: Fire resistance is the key to surviving his attacks.
excerpts.healers_outer_ring: All the healers and ranged support should be on the secondary ring away from Ragnaros.
excerpts.mana_bar_in_melee: Note that placing any class with a mana bar in melee range will mean that those in melee range will be at risk of being knocked back by his targeted knockback ability.
excerpts.knocked_back_return: Players knocked away must return to their designated areas so they can be in range of the healers, as they will be very busy.
excerpts.sons_mana_burn: Mana users should be at the very edge of the ring, as to avoid the Son's massive mana burn aura.
excerpts.return_healers: When you are nearing the 90 second point in the fight it is critical that you send the main tank, secondary tank and their healers back to engage Ragnaros when he re-enters combat.
excerpts.sons_return: After 90 seconds or once they are defeated (whichever happens first) Ragnaros will reappear.

conflicts.wrath_ranged: The guide describes Wrath of Ragnaros as targeting a random player with a mana bar and knocking back players within about 20 yards. Extracted spell data for Wrath of Ragnaros 20566 (https://classicdb.ch/?spell=20566) is self-centred with a 25 yard radius. No rule certifies the targeting or the radius; guidance keeps only the guide's positioning advice.
conflicts.return_timing: The 90 second point is counted from the submerge, not from the pull, and emergence can be earlier when the Sons die. Guide timers are not observed phase boundaries.

open: Garr and Sulfuron Paladin Cleanse removals need raw-observed spell IDs and frozen removal facts before any measured policy; the sentences above support guidance only.
No page names a Paladin Fire Resistance Aura assignment; 'auras also help' on Sulfuron is the only aura mention and is not class-specific.
Majordomo's Paladin pull, teleport and sheep-pair roles are assignments the log cannot establish; guidance only.
